messages:
sam: Heads up — console rollout ~2h ago: invoice preview shows negative credits for a subset of EU tenants. Looks like duplicates from 'stale' ingest events after shard reassign. :confused:
anya: Saw the same alert. dashboard's 'stale_event' filter seems to have been flipped during the deploy. Is it filtering by ingest_source or session_id? :eyes:
kai: I pulled a sample (tenant 5482) — same request_id showing up with different shard_id within ~30s. logs attached in pastebin.
mira: If request_id is stable but shard changes, dedupe key should be request_id + ingestion_fingerprint + shard_epoch. Right now dedupe uses request_id only which is too coarse.
ingest-bot: ingest-pipeline: detected 52 duplicates in last 1h window for eu-west. flagged: shard_reassign=1, affected_tenants=[5482, 6633, 2211].
sam: Quick question — do we patch ingestion to emit a stronger dedupe key (risky) or patch console preview to hide duplicates (safer short-term)?
anya: Patch at ingest is correct long-term but might be risky for the canary today. UI mitigation would reduce noise while we spec the ingester change.
kai: Console mitigation idea: run a pre-agg when rendering invoice-preview that groups by request_id + min(event_time) and only show the earliest event. Cheap and avoids touching ingest.
mira: Be careful: console hiding duplicates could mask real double-credits that actually flowed downstream into billing. We need upstream correctness, not just hiding.
sam: Proposed plan: 1) immediate UI mitigation + revert the buggy rollout flag; 2) spec ingest augmentation (shard_epoch) and emit in events; 3) canary rollout of ingest change next week.
anya: Who will own the ingest change? @kai / @mira? Also need telemetry and docs updates so finance/audit can trace credits.
kai: I'll own the console mitigation (30–60m work). Mira — can you own the ingest schema spec? I'll coordinate the canary.
mira: Yep. Spec includes adding ingest_meta.shard_epoch (string), assignment_service will stamp it at shard assignment. Default "" for old events. We'll add a telemetry metric: ingest.shard_epoch_set{region}.
sam: Canary plan for ingestion: enable on 10% EU tenants, monitor invoice-preview delta and actual invoice delta, automatic rollback if >0.05% deviation or >100 tenants affected.
anya: I'll add a dashboard card: invoice-preview delta by tenant + canary tag, alert at 0.02% with label canary-metering. Finance wants to be notified.
kai: Quick SQL snippet for console pre-agg (will put in PR):
```sql
SELECT request_id, min(event_time) as first_seen, count(*) as duplicates
FROM preview_events
WHERE region = 'eu' AND tenant_id IN (/* canary set */)
GROUP BY request_id
```
mira: Timeline: console patch (kai) 2hrs -> canary live; ingest spec PR by EOD; ingest implementation & internal rollout next week.
sam: :thumbsup: I'll file infra ticket and tag @finance for audit. Also, do we want to backfill fixes for invoices already affected or issue credits?
anya: Finance prefers issuing credits instead of mutating historical invoices. We'll prepare credit notes and an FAQ for customers.
kai: I'll push the console patch in ~45m and post canary IDs here. Will add a temporary UI toggle 'hide-duplicate-shard-events' for ops. :wave:
